cards.en:
Think of it like a class group chat plus a shared locker. Everyone can send messages, and everyone can use the same things instead of buying their own.

What it is: a computer network is computers and peripheral devices (extra devices such as printers, scanners, storage) joined by cables or wireless links.

Why we build one:

  • Share hardware: 40 PCs can use 2 printers.
  • Share files and software: one copy on a server.
  • Share one Internet connection.
  • Fast, cheap communication: email, messaging, video calls.
  • Centralised storage makes backup easy.

Downsides: security risks (hackers, malware spreads through the network); cost of hardware and an administrator; if a key device (server, switch) fails, many users are affected.

Exam wording: A computer network is an interconnection of computers and peripheral devices. Its purpose is to exchange information and share hardware and software resources.
cards.zh:
可以想成「班级群组 + 共用储物柜」：大家可以互相传讯息，也可以共用东西，不用每人买一份。

定义：computer network 就是把电脑和 peripheral devices（周边设备，如打印机、扫描器、储存装置）用电缆或无线连接起来。

为什么要建网络：

  • 共享硬件：40 部电脑共用 2 部打印机。
  • 共享文件和软件：server 上放一份就够。
  • 共享同一条 Internet 线路。
  • 沟通快又便宜：email、即时讯息、视像会议。
  • 集中储存，备份方便。

坏处：保安风险（黑客、恶意软件会经网络扩散）；设备和管理员的成本；server 或 switch 坏了，很多人受影响。

考试写法：A computer network is an interconnection of computers and peripheral devices. Its purpose is to exchange information and share hardware and software resources.

ex.q: A school has 40 computers but only 2 laser printers. Give TWO benefits of connecting them in a network.
ex.a:
1. All 40 computers can share the 2 printers (hardware sharing), so the school saves the cost of more printers.
2. Students can save work in a shared server folder, so files are backed up centrally and can be opened from any computer.
ex.az:
1. 40 部电脑共用 2 部打印机，省钱。
2. 文件存在 server 共享文件夹，集中备份，任何电脑都能开。

ex.q: Give ONE disadvantage of networking the school computers.
ex.a:
1. Think about what can go wrong when devices are connected.
2. Answer: malware on one computer can spread through the network to other computers (security risk).
Another accepted answer: if the server fails, no one can get their files.
ex.az:
1. 想想连起来后会出什么问题。
2. 答：一部电脑中毒，恶意软件可经网络传到其他电脑（保安风险）。也可答：server 坏了，大家都拿不到文件。

ex.q: A student writes: "The purpose of a network is to connect to the Internet." Is this a full answer?
ex.a:
1. Mistake: Internet access is only one resource that can be shared. A network with no Internet (e.g. an exam room LAN) is still a network.
2. Correct answer: to exchange information and share hardware and software resources (files, printers, software, Internet connection).
ex.az:
1. 错误：上网只是可共享的其中一种资源；没有 Internet 的 LAN 也是网络。
2. 正确写法：exchange information and share hardware and software resources。

frames.en: Each PC is alone. To print, you copy the file to a USB stick and walk to the PC with the printer.
frames.zh: 每部电脑各自独立。要打印就要用 USB 手指拷贝，走到接着打印机的电脑。

frames.en: All devices connect to a switch. Now they form a network.
frames.zh: 所有设备接到 switch，就组成网络。

frames.en: PC 1 sends a print job through the switch to the shared printer.
frames.zh: PC 1 经 switch 把打印工作送到共享打印机。

frames.en: PC 2 saves homework on the file server; PC 3 opens the same file. The server can be backed up once for everyone.
frames.zh: PC 2 把功课存到 file server，PC 3 可以打开同一个文件；server 统一备份。

cards.en:
Analogy: a LAN is like the roads inside one housing estate; a WAN is like the highways joining many estates and cities.

LAN (Local Area Network): a network in a small area: a home, a school, an office. Usually owned and managed by one organisation, using its own cables and switches.

WAN (Wide Area Network): many LANs joined together over a large area: districts, countries. It normally uses lines rented from telecom companies or ISPs. The Internet is the largest WAN.

LANWAN
CoverageSmallLarge
Setup costLowHigh
Data transfer rateHighLower
OwnerOne organisationUses ISP / telecom lines

Exam wording: A LAN covers a small geographical area such as a school. A WAN consists of many LANs and covers a large geographical area; the Internet is the largest WAN.
cards.zh:
比喻：LAN 像一个屋苑里面的小路；WAN 像连接很多屋苑和城市的高速公路。

LAN（局域网）：覆盖小范围：家、学校、办公室。通常由一个机构拥有和管理，用自己的电缆和 switch。

WAN（广域网）：由很多个 LAN 连起来，覆盖地区、国家等大范围，通常租用电讯公司或 ISP 的线路。Internet 是最大的 WAN。

LANWAN
覆盖范围小大
建立成本低高
传输速率高较低
拥有者单一机构租用 ISP／电讯线路

考试写法：A LAN covers a small geographical area such as a school. A WAN consists of many LANs and covers a large geographical area; the Internet is the largest WAN.

ex.q: A company has offices in Hong Kong and Tokyo. Each office has its own network. What type of network links the two offices?
ex.a:
1. Each office network = a LAN (small area).
2. Joining LANs across countries = a WAN.
Answer: WAN, usually using lines leased from a telecom company / ISP.
ex.az:
1. 每间办公室是 LAN。
2. 跨国连接多个 LAN 就是 WAN，通常租用电讯／ISP 线路。

ex.q: Why is a LAN usually faster than a WAN?
ex.a:
1. A LAN uses short cables and the organisation's own switches, shared by few users.
2. A WAN sends data over long distances through many routers and shared ISP lines.
Answer: LAN has a higher data transfer rate because of short distance and fewer devices in between.
ex.az:
1. LAN 距离短、设备少、自己拥有。
2. WAN 距离长、经过很多 router、线路与人共用。所以 LAN 传输速率较高。

ex.q: A student says: "The Internet is a very big LAN." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: a LAN is a single network in a small area, owned by one organisation.
2. The Internet joins millions of LANs worldwide through ISPs.
Correct: the Internet is the largest WAN.
ex.az:
1. 错误：LAN 是小范围、单一机构的网络。
2. Internet 经 ISP 连接全世界无数 LAN，所以是最大的 WAN。

frames.en: PCs connect to a switch in one office. This is a LAN.
frames.zh: 一间办公室内的电脑接到 switch，就是 LAN。

frames.en: Another office has its own LAN.
frames.zh: 另一间办公室也有自己的 LAN。

frames.t: Join them through routers and an ISP
frames.en: Each LAN has a router. The routers connect over ISP / leased lines. Many LANs joined = a WAN.
frames.zh: 每个 LAN 有 router，经 ISP／租用线路相连。多个 LAN 连起来 = WAN。

cards.t: Misconception: LAN vs WAN is not only about distance
cards.tz: 误解：LAN/WAN 只看覆盖范围
cards.en:
The trap: many students think "small area = LAN, big area = WAN" and stop there.

What really decides it: how the devices are connected.

  • Devices joined directly by your own cables/switch → LAN.
  • Devices joined through an ISP (public network) → WAN, even if they are in the same building.

Example: two flats next door both use home broadband. A file sent from one to the other travels through the ISP, so that link is part of a WAN.

We still usually say a WAN covers a large area, because it is very hard to run your own cable over a long distance.

Exam wording: The difference between a LAN and a WAN depends on how the devices are connected. Once computers are connected through an ISP, they form a WAN even in a small coverage area.
cards.zh:
陷阱：很多同学以为「范围小 = LAN，范围大 = WAN」就完了。

真正的分别：设备是怎样连接的。

  • 用自己的电缆／switch 直接连 → LAN。
  • 经 ISP（公共网络）连接 → WAN，就算在同一座大厦。

例子：隔壁两个单位都用家居宽带，一家传文件给另一家，数据经过 ISP，所以这条连接属于 WAN。

我们仍「通常」说 WAN 覆盖大范围，因为自己拉长距离电缆非常困难。

考试写法：The difference between a LAN and a WAN depends on how the devices are connected. Once computers are connected through an ISP, they form a WAN even in a small coverage area.

ex.q: True or false: "The difference between a LAN and a WAN depends solely on the coverage area." Explain.
ex.a:
1. Key word: solely.
2. Mistake in the statement: it ignores how the devices are connected.
3. Answer: False. It depends on how devices are connected; computers connected through an ISP form a WAN even in a small area.
ex.az:
1. 关键字 solely（只）。
2. 句子错在忽略了连接方式。
3. 答：错。取决于连接方式；经 ISP 连接，即使范围小也是 WAN。

ex.q: Two shops on the same street each have their own broadband. The owner sends a file from Shop A's PC to Shop B's PC. Is this LAN or WAN communication?
ex.a:
1. Shop A's PC → its router → ISP → Shop B's router → Shop B's PC.
2. The data passes through the ISP.
Answer: WAN, even though the shops are only metres apart.
ex.az:
1. 数据路径：A 店 PC → router → ISP → B 店 router → PC。
2. 经过 ISP，所以是 WAN，即使两店很近。

ex.q: Why do we usually say a WAN covers a large area?
ex.a:
1. To connect far-away sites, you cannot easily lay your own cable across roads and seas.
2. So far-away sites are almost always linked through ISPs/telecom lines.
Answer: it is extremely difficult to connect computers directly with a cable over a long distance, so long-distance links are usually WANs.
ex.az:
1. 远距离很难自己铺电缆。
2. 所以远距离几乎都经 ISP 连接，故通常说 WAN 范围大。

frames.en: Shop A and Shop B run one cable between their switches. Data never leaves their own equipment. This is a LAN.
frames.zh: 两店之间自己拉电缆接 switch，数据不经外人设备：LAN。

frames.en: Now each shop only has broadband. Data goes up to the ISP and back down. Same 10 m distance, but it is WAN communication.
frames.zh: 两店各用宽带，数据经 ISP 绕一圈。距离一样 10 米，却是 WAN。

cards.en:
Analogy: a restaurant. Customers (clients) order; the kitchen (server) cooks and serves. The manager (administrator) decides who may order what.

How it works:

  • A server is a dedicated, powerful, reliable computer that provides a network service.
  • A client is a device that requests a service from the server.
  • Resources are stored centrally on the server; the administrator controls access (user accounts, permissions).

Types of server:

  • Web server: hosts web pages and media (needs large storage).
  • File server: stores shared files.
  • Print server: shares printers.
  • Game server: runs multiplayer games.
  • Application server: runs web apps (e.g. online office suites) so they need not be installed on each PC (needs high computing power).

Exam wording: In a client-server network, a centralised administrative system (server) is present. All resources are stored in the server and shared among the clients. Clients request services from the server.
cards.zh:
比喻：餐厅。客人（client）点菜，厨房（server）煮好送出，经理（administrator）决定谁可以点什么。

运作：

  • server：专用、强大、可靠的电脑，提供网络服务。
  • client：向 server 请求服务的设备。
  • 资源集中放在 server，由管理员控制权限（帐户、权限设定）。

server 种类：

  • Web server：存网页和多媒体（要大储存量）。
  • File server：存共享文件。
  • Print server：共享打印机。
  • Game server：多人游戏。
  • Application server：运行网上应用程序（如网上 office），每部电脑不用安装（要高运算能力）。

考试写法：In a client-server network, a centralised administrative system (server) is present. All resources are stored in the server and shared among the clients. Clients request services from the server.

ex.q: Name the type of server needed: (a) students submit homework into a shared folder; (b) a multiplayer online game; (c) an online word processor used in a browser.
ex.a:
1. Shared folder → file server.
2. Multiplayer game → game server.
3. Web app used without installing → application server.
ex.az:
1. 共享文件夹 → file server。
2. 多人游戏 → game server。
3. 浏览器内的应用程序 → application server。

ex.q: Why does an application server need more computing power than a file server?
ex.a:
1. A file server mainly stores and sends files (storage + disk speed).
2. An application server runs the program for every client at the same time.
Answer: it must process many users' requests/computations, so it needs a powerful CPU and lots of RAM.
ex.az:
1. file server 主要是存取文件。
2. application server 要同时为所有 client 运行程序，所以要强 CPU 和大量 RAM。

ex.q: A student writes: "A server is just any computer that is switched on first." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: a server is defined by its role, not by when it is turned on.
2. Correct: a server provides specific network services to clients; it is usually dedicated and more powerful and reliable than a PC.
ex.az:
1. 错误：server 是按角色定义，不是先开机就是。
2. 正确：server 为 client 提供特定网络服务，通常专用且比一般电脑强、可靠。

frames.en: A student's PC (client) asks the file server: "Give me homework.docx".
frames.zh: 学生电脑（client）向 file server 请求 homework.docx。

frames.en: The server checks the user account. The administrator set this folder to read only for students.
frames.zh: server 检查帐户权限；管理员把这个文件夹设为学生 read only。

frames.en: Permission OK, so the server sends the file back to the client.
frames.zh: 权限合格，server 把文件传回 client。

frames.en: Server fails: no client can get files. This is the main weakness.
frames.zh: server 坏了，所有 client 都拿不到文件：这是最大弱点。

cards.t: Common types of servers and the domain controller
cards.tz: 常见服务器类型与 domain controller
cards.en:
Plain idea: a server is a computer whose whole job is to serve other devices. Different servers do different jobs, and each job needs different hardware.

ServerFunctionNeeds
Web serverHosts web pages and their multimedia filesLarger storage
Game serverLets several devices play multiplayer online gamesHigher computation power
Print serverShares printers over a networkPrinter connected directly to the server
Application serverHosts web-based applications (e.g. Google Docs, Office 365) so users need not install them on each computerHigher computation power
Domain controllerStores user account information, authenticates users and authorises access rights-

A device chosen as a server is dedicated to running services, so it must be more powerful and reliable than a normal personal device.

Why a domain controller in a school library? Students join and leave every year. With a domain controller the technician adds or deletes accounts once on the server, and every library PC accepts the login. With local user accounts, the technician must change every computer one by one.

Exam wording: A domain controller stores user account information, authenticates users and authorises user access rights, giving centralised user management.
cards.zh:
简单理解：服务器就是专门替其他设备服务的电脑。不同服务器做不同工作，所需硬件也不同。

服务器功能需要
Web server存放网页及其多媒体文件较大储存量
Game server让多部设备玩多人网上游戏较高运算能力
Print server在网络上共享打印机打印机直接连到服务器
Application server存放网上应用程序（如 Google Docs、Office 365），用户毋须每部电脑安装较高运算能力
Domain controller储存用户账户资料、认证用户（authenticate）、授权存取权限（authorise）-

被指定为服务器的设备会专职运行服务，所以要比一般个人设备更强大、更可靠。

为何学校图书馆用 domain controller？每年都有学生加入或离开。用 domain controller，技术员只需在服务器上新增／删除账户一次，所有电脑都能登入；用本机账户（local user account）就要每部电脑逐一修改。

考试写法：A domain controller stores user account information, authenticates users and authorises user access rights, giving centralised user management.

ex.q: A school puts 30 new PCs in the library. Students log in with school accounts. Should it use a domain controller or local accounts? Why?
ex.a:
1. Use a domain controller (client-server).
2. Accounts are stored centrally, so the technician adds/deletes an account once on the server instead of on 30 PCs.
3. Students change every year, so this saves a lot of work and keeps accounts consistent.
ex.az:
1. 用 domain controller（client-server）。
2. 账户集中储存，只需在服务器改一次，不用改 30 部电脑。
3. 学生每年变动，省工夫又保持一致。

ex.q: Which server type needs larger storage, and which needs higher computation power: web server, game server, application server?
ex.a:
1. Web server: larger storage (holds pages and media).
2. Game server and application server: higher computation power (run games/apps for many users).
ex.az:
1. Web server：要较大储存量。
2. Game server、application server：要较高运算能力。

ex.q: A student says: "A domain controller is a server that hosts web pages." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: that describes a web server.
2. A domain controller stores user accounts, authenticates users and authorises access rights.
ex.az:
1. 错误：那是 web server。
2. Domain controller 负责储存用户账户、认证用户及授权存取权限。

cards.en:
Analogy: friends swapping comics directly with each other. No library, no librarian: everyone lends and borrows.

How it works: in a peer-to-peer (P2P) network there is no central server. Each device (a peer) shares its own files and connects directly to other peers using dedicated software (e.g. BitTorrent). Each device is both a client and a server.

Pros:

  • Lower cost: no server to buy.
  • Easier to set up: no server knowledge needed.
  • More flexible: easy to add or remove devices.

Cons:

  • Less secure: no centralised management.
  • Dedicated software required.
  • Hard to control versions: copies are spread over many computers.

Exam wording: In a peer-to-peer network, devices share resources without a centralised administrative system; devices connect and make requests directly to one another.
cards.zh:
比喻：朋友之间直接互借漫画，没有图书馆和管理员，每个人都可以借出和借入。

运作：peer-to-peer (P2P) 网络没有中央 server。每部设备（peer）分享自己的文件，用专用软件（如 BitTorrent）直接连接其他 peer。每部设备同时是 client 和 server。

优点：

  • 成本低：不用买 server。
  • 容易设置：不需 server 知识。
  • 灵活：容易加入或移除设备。

缺点：

  • 较不安全：没有集中管理。
  • 需要专用软件。
  • 版本难控制：文件分散在多部电脑。

考试写法：In a peer-to-peer network, devices share resources without a centralised administrative system; devices connect and make requests directly to one another.

ex.q: Three friends want to share game videos at home without buying extra equipment. Which network model suits them? Give TWO reasons.
ex.a:
1. Few devices, low budget, no technical admin → P2P.
2. Reason 1: lower cost, no server needed.
3. Reason 2: easier to set up, no server knowledge required.
ex.az:
1. 设备少、预算低 → P2P。
2. 不用买 server，成本低。
3. 设置容易，不需 server 知识。

ex.q: In a P2P network, Ann edits report.docx on her PC while Ben edits his own copy. What problem may happen?
ex.a:
1. There is no single central copy.
2. Two different versions now exist.
Answer: difficult to control versions of resources; people may use outdated or conflicting copies.
ex.az:
1. 没有单一中央副本。
2. 出现两个不同版本 → 版本难控制，可能用到旧版。

ex.q: A student writes: "In P2P, each computer is only a client." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: if everyone were only a client, nobody would provide files.
2. Correct: each device can act as both a client and a server: it requests files and also provides its own files.
ex.az:
1. 错误：如果全部只是 client，就没有人提供文件。
2. 正确：每部设备同时可以是 client 和 server。

frames.en: Three PCs run file-sharing software. No server exists.
frames.zh: 三部电脑运行分享软件，没有 server。

frames.en: Peer A requests part 1 of a video directly from Peer B (B acts as server).
frames.zh: A 直接向 B 要影片第 1 部分，此时 B 是 server。

frames.t: A also gets parts from C
frames.en: At the same time A downloads part 2 from Peer C.
frames.zh: 同时 A 从 C 下载第 2 部分。

frames.en: A now has the file and shares it to others: every peer is client and server.
frames.zh: A 有了文件后也上传给别人：每个 peer 都是 client 兼 server。

cards.t: P2P file sharing tools and the "P2P payment" trap
cards.tz: P2P 文件分享工具与「P2P 付款」陷阱
cards.en:
Plain idea: P2P file sharing means devices pass files straight to each other, without a central server.

  • BitTorrent (BT): a protocol for P2P file sharing, used for large files such as videos and installation files. A file can come in different parts from different computers at the same time, so download time can be shorter. Clients: BitTorrent, μTorrent.
  • Google Nearby Share (Android) and AirDrop (iOS): simple P2P sharing between two phones. Wireless technologies such as NFC, Bluetooth or Wi-Fi let them talk directly without any Internet connection.

The trap: mobile wallets advertise "P2P payments". This does not mean a peer-to-peer network. Here P2P means person-to-person: you send money from your wallet to another person's wallet over the Internet. It uses a client-server network, because the bank must record every transaction on a centralised server.

Exam wording: P2P payment means person-to-person payment; it uses a client-server network because every transaction is recorded on the bank's centralised server.
cards.zh:
简单理解：P2P 文件分享就是设备之间直接传文件，没有中央服务器。

  • BitTorrent（BT）：P2P 文件分享协定，常用于下载影片、安装档等大文件。可同时从不同电脑下载文件的不同部分，所以下载时间可缩短。客户端：BitTorrent、μTorrent。
  • Google Nearby Share（Android）及 AirDrop（iOS）：两部手机之间的简单 P2P 分享。NFC、Bluetooth 或 Wi-Fi 等无线技术让设备毋须上网也能直接沟通。

陷阱：电子钱包的「P2P 付款」不是 peer-to-peer 网络，而是 person-to-person（个人对个人）：经互联网把钱由你的钱包转到对方钱包。它用的是 client-server 网络，因为银行要把每宗交易记录在中央服务器。

考试写法：P2P payment means person-to-person payment; it uses a client-server network because every transaction is recorded on the bank's centralised server.

ex.q: Why can BitTorrent download a large file faster than one busy server?
ex.a:
1. The file is split into parts.
2. Different parts are downloaded from different peers at the same time.
3. So the load is spread and total download time can be shorter.
ex.az:
1. 文件分成多个部分。
2. 同时由不同 peer 下载不同部分。
3. 负载分散，下载时间可缩短。

ex.q: Ada sends a photo to Ben with AirDrop on a plane with no Internet. How is this possible?
ex.a:
1. AirDrop is P2P file sharing.
2. The two phones connect directly using wireless technology (Bluetooth/Wi-Fi).
3. No server or Internet connection is needed.
ex.az:
1. AirDrop 是 P2P 分享。
2. 两部手机用无线技术直接连接。
3. 不需服务器或互联网。

ex.q: A student writes: "A mobile wallet's P2P transfer is a peer-to-peer network service." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: P2P here means person-to-person.
2. It uses a client-server network because the bank records every transaction on a centralised server.
ex.az:
1. 错误：这里 P2P 指 person-to-person。
2. 属 client-server，银行要在中央服务器记录每宗交易。

cards.tz: 客户端-服务器与对等网络比较
cards.en:
Analogy: client-server is a school library with a librarian (safe, organised, but costs staff). P2P is friends swapping books (free and easy, but messy and less safe).

Client-serverP2P
ProsMore secure (admin manages users)
Easier to keep versions consistent
Easier to back up and recover data		Lower cost
Easier to set up
More flexible to add/remove devices
ConsHigh server setup and maintenance cost
Harder to set up/maintain
Service stops if the server is down		Less secure
Dedicated software needed
Hard to control versions

How to choose: school / company / needs security and backup → client-server. A few home computers, low budget → P2P.

Exam wording: always give the advantage and the reason, e.g. "Client-server is more secure because user accounts and access rights are managed centrally by the administrator."
cards.zh:
比喻：client-server 像有管理员的学校图书馆（安全、整齐，但要人手成本）；P2P 像朋友互换书（免费方便，但乱、不安全）。

Client-serverP2P
优点较安全（管理员管理用户）
版本容易一致
容易备份和复原		成本低
容易设置
加减设备灵活
缺点server 建立和维护成本高
较难设置维护
server 坏了服务就停		较不安全
要专用软件
版本难控制

怎样选：学校／公司、需要保安和备份 → client-server；家中几部电脑、预算少 → P2P。

考试写法：优点要加原因，例如 "Client-server is more secure because user accounts and access rights are managed centrally by the administrator."

ex.q: A secondary school with 300 computers stores students' exam marks. Should it use client-server or P2P? Give TWO reasons.
ex.a:
1. Many users + sensitive data → client-server.
2. More secure: the administrator controls user accounts and access rights to the marks.
3. Easier to back up and recover data: all data is on the server.
ex.az:
1. 用户多、资料敏感 → client-server。
2. 管理员集中控制权限，较安全。
3. 资料集中在 server，容易备份和复原。

ex.q: Give ONE disadvantage of client-server for this school and how to reduce it.
ex.a:
1. Disadvantage: service stops once the server is down.
2. Reduce it: use a backup server / redundant power supply (UPS), regular maintenance.
ex.az:
1. 缺点：server 坏了服务停止。
2. 减低方法：后备 server、UPS 不断电、定期维护。

ex.q: A student answers: "P2P is better because it is faster." Why will this get no marks?
ex.a:
1. Mistake: speed is not a listed advantage of P2P, and no reason is given.
2. Better answer: P2P has lower cost because no dedicated server is needed, or it is easier to set up.
ex.az:
1. 错误：「较快」不是 P2P 的标准优点，也没有原因。
2. 应写：不用专用 server，成本较低；或设置较容易。

demo.title: Client-server vs P2P side by side

frames.en: All clients talk to one server. Admin controls access and backs up the server.
frames.zh: 所有 client 都连到同一部 server，管理员控制权限并备份。

frames.en: Peers connect directly. No central control, no single backup point.
frames.zh: peer 之间直接连接，没有集中控制，也没有统一备份。

frames.en: Client-server: server down → everyone loses the service. P2P: one peer down → the others still share.
frames.zh: client-server：server 坏 → 全部停；P2P：一部 peer 坏，其余照样分享。
hl: service stops if server is down

cards.en:
Analogy: an office building gives staff an internal phone line, a meeting room, and shared cupboards. A network gives the same kinds of services, digitally.

Three groups of network services:

  1. Internal communications: email, instant messages inside the organisation.
  2. Conferencing: real-time audio/video meetings.
  3. Resource sharing: file sharing, hardware sharing, software sharing, Internet access sharing.

Why internal communications help:

  • Efficiency: talk without leaving your desk.
  • Convenience: works anywhere you are connected.
  • Privacy: only the intended recipient gets the message.

For confidential messages, companies use their Intranet (a private network used only inside the organisation) instead of the public Internet.

Exam wording: Network services include internal communications, conferencing and resource sharing (file, hardware, software and Internet access sharing).
cards.zh:
比喻：办公大楼给员工内线电话、会议室、共用柜；网络以数码方式提供同类服务。

三类网络服务：

  1. Internal communications（内部通讯）：机构内的 email、即时讯息。
  2. Conferencing（会议）：实时语音／视像会议。
  3. Resource sharing（资源共享）：文件、硬件、软件、上网服务共享。

内部通讯的好处：

  • Efficiency：不用离开座位就能沟通。
  • Convenience：只要连上网络就能用。
  • Privacy：只有指定收件人收到。

机密讯息会经公司的 Intranet（只供机构内部使用的私人网络）传送，而不是公共 Internet。

考试写法：Network services include internal communications, conferencing and resource sharing (file, hardware, software and Internet access sharing).

ex.q: List the FOUR kinds of resource sharing a network provides.
ex.a:
1. File sharing
2. Hardware sharing (e.g. printers)
3. Software sharing
4. Internet access service sharing
ex.az: 1. 文件共享 2. 硬件共享 3. 软件共享 4. 上网服务共享

ex.q: A bank wants staff to send confidential client data to each other. Should they use the Internet or the Intranet? Why?
ex.a:
1. Confidential data must not travel on the public network.
2. Answer: Intranet, because it is a private network used only inside the bank, so outsiders cannot easily intercept the messages.
ex.az:
1. 机密资料不应经公共网络。
2. 用 Intranet：只供银行内部，外人难截取。

ex.q: A student lists "privacy" as a benefit of internal communication by saying "no one can ever read the message". What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. Mistake: overclaiming. Networks can still be hacked.
2. Correct wording: only the intended recipient receives the message (unlike a notice board or loud speaker).
ex.az:
1. 错误：说得太绝对，网络仍可被入侵。
2. 正确：只有指定收件人会收到讯息。

cards.en:
Analogy: bandwidth is like the width of a water pipe. A video call pushes a lot of "water" (data) every second. A thin pipe means a choppy, blurry call.

Conferencing gives real-time collaboration with audio and video for people in different places.

Bandwidth = the maximum data transmission rate, measured in bits per second (bps), e.g. 100 Mbps.

  • Low bandwidth → laggy, low-quality sound and video.
  • So video is usually compressed (made smaller) before sending.
  • Higher-resolution camera → sharper video, but needs more bandwidth.

Ways to improve quality: use a network with a higher data transfer rate, compress the video, or lower the resolution if bandwidth is limited.

Exam wording: The quality of conferencing depends on the data transmission rate (bandwidth). Video signals are compressed before transmission to reduce the bandwidth required.
cards.zh:
比喻：bandwidth 像水管的粗幼。视像通话每秒要流过很多「水」（数据），水管太幼就会卡、模糊。

Conferencing：为不同地点的人提供实时语音和视像协作。

Bandwidth（带宽）= 最高数据传输速率，单位 bits per second (bps)，如 100 Mbps。

  • 带宽低 → 声音、画面卡顿，质素差。
  • 所以视频通常先压缩（compress）再传送。
  • 镜头解像度越高，画面越清，但需要更多带宽。

改善方法：用传输速率更高的网络、压缩视频、带宽不够时降低解像度。

考试写法：The quality of conferencing depends on the data transmission rate (bandwidth). Video signals are compressed before transmission to reduce the bandwidth required.

ex.q: An uncompressed video stream needs 120 Mbps, but the home line gives 50 Mbps. What can be done?
ex.a:
1. Needed 120 Mbps > available 50 Mbps → the call will lag.
2. Fixes: compress the video (e.g. to below 50 Mbps), lower the resolution, or upgrade to a line with higher bandwidth.
ex.az:
1. 需要 120 Mbps > 只有 50 Mbps → 会卡。
2. 压缩视频、降低解像度、或升级带宽。

ex.q: A school buys 4K cameras for online lessons, but video becomes choppy. Explain why.
ex.a:
1. 4K = higher resolution = more data per second.
2. The network bandwidth is not enough for this data rate.
Answer: higher-resolution video needs more bandwidth; the existing bandwidth cannot carry it smoothly.
ex.az:
1. 4K 解像度高，每秒数据多。
2. 现有带宽不够，所以卡。

ex.q: A student writes: "Bandwidth is measured in bytes." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: bytes measure size/storage, not rate.
2. Correct: bandwidth is measured in bits per second (bps), e.g. Mbps. Note 1 byte = 8 bits.
ex.az:
1. 错误：byte 是大小单位，不是速率。
2. 正确：bandwidth 单位是 bps（bits per second）。1 byte = 8 bits。

frames.en: Raw 1080p video is large, e.g. far more than the line can carry.
frames.zh: 原始 1080p 视频数据量很大，超过线路能承载。

frames.en: Software compresses the video so the data rate fits the bandwidth.
frames.zh: 软件压缩视频，使数据率小于带宽。

frames.en: Compressed data flows smoothly to the receiver, who decompresses and plays it.
frames.zh: 压缩后数据顺畅传到对方，对方解压播放。

cards.en:
Analogy: a shared cupboard in the staff room with labelled shelves. Some shelves you may only look at; some you may add to; the boss can do anything.

SOHO (Small Office / Home Office) networks share files and printers. The administrator creates folders on a server or a NAS (Network-attached Storage: a storage box plugged straight into the network) and sets access control:

  • Read only: open and copy, cannot change.
  • Read and write: open, edit, add files.
  • Full control: also delete and change permissions.

Users see the folder as a network drive (e.g. drive H:).

Advantages of centralised storage:

  • Data stays consistent across many devices.
  • Saves local storage space.
  • People can work on the same folder at the same time.
  • Easier backup, and helps recover lost local data.

Exam wording: Storing data on a central server maintains consistency of data, facilitates backup and allows users to work on the same folder at the same time.
cards.zh:
比喻：教员室有标签的共用柜，有些格子只准看、有些可以放东西，老板什么都能做。

SOHO（小型办公室／家居办公室）网络会共享文件和打印机。管理员在 server 或 NAS（Network-attached Storage，直接接上网络的储存盒）开文件夹，设定 access control：

  • Read only：只能开和复制，不能改。
  • Read and write：可开、可改、可加文件。
  • Full control：还可以删除和改权限。

用户会看到一个 network drive（如 H: 盘）。

集中储存的好处：

  • 多部设备的资料保持一致。
  • 节省本机储存空间。
  • 多人可同时用同一文件夹。
  • 方便备份，也能帮忙复原本机资料。

考试写法：Storing data on a central server maintains consistency of data, facilitates backup and allows users to work on the same folder at the same time.

ex.q: Teachers upload worksheets; students must download but not change them. What access right should students have on the Worksheets folder?
ex.a:
1. Students need to open/copy only.
2. Answer: read only. Teachers get read and write (or full control).
ex.az:
1. 学生只需开和复制。
2. 学生 read only；老师 read and write 或 full control。

ex.q: A Homework folder: students must upload files but should not delete others' work. Which right fits best, and what risk remains?
ex.a:
1. Upload needs writing → read and write (not full control).
2. Risk: with plain read and write, students might still overwrite files; the admin may use per-user subfolders.
ex.az:
1. 要上传 → read and write，不给 full control。
2. 风险：仍可能覆盖别人文件，可为每人设子文件夹。

ex.q: A student says: "Centralised storage means you don't need backups." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: the server can still fail or be attacked.
2. Correct: centralised storage makes backup easier (one place to back up), but backup is still needed.
ex.az:
1. 错误：server 也会坏或被攻击。
2. 正确：集中储存令备份更方便（只备份一处），但仍要备份。

cards.en:
Analogy: one family printer. Either it hangs off Dad's laptop (Dad's laptop must be on), or it plugs into the home router so anyone can print any time.

Sharing hardware (printers, scanners, file servers) makes full use of devices and saves money.

Method A: printer on computer A by USB, sharedMethod B: network printer (own UTP cable / Wi-Fi)
ProsEasy to set up and control; A can monitor printing quotaWorks without any computer on; printer handles authentication, quota and job priority itself
ConsOnly usable when computer A is on; A's CPU/RAM are used, so A runs slower while printingPrinter costs more (needs network card); needs network setup

Also note: a network printer handles its own authentication, printing quota and job priority (called printer spooling). Computer A, when it shares printer Y, acts as a print server; when it browses the web it is a web client, so one computer can be both.

Exam wording: A printer shared through computer A can only be used when computer A is switched on, and it uses A's resources. A network printer connects directly to the network and does not depend on any computer.
cards.zh:
比喻：一家人共用一部打印机：要么接在爸爸的手提电脑（爸爸电脑要开着），要么直接接到家中 router，谁都能随时打印。

共享硬件（打印机、扫描器、file server）能充分利用设备、省钱。

方法 A：USB 接电脑 A 再共享方法 B：网络打印机（自己的 UTP／Wi-Fi）
优点容易设置和控制；A 可监察打印配额不用任何电脑开机；打印机自己处理认证、配额、优先次序
缺点A 开机才能用；占用 A 的 CPU/RAM，A 变慢打印机较贵（要网卡）；要设定网络

补充：网络打印机自己处理认证、打印配额及工作优先次序（称为 printer spooling）。电脑 A 共享打印机 Y 时是 print server，浏览网页时是 web client，同一部电脑可同时担任两个角色。

考试写法：A printer shared through computer A can only be used when computer A is switched on, and it uses A's resources. A network printer connects directly to the network and does not depend on any computer.

ex.q: The library printer is shared via the librarian's PC. Students complain they cannot print after 5 pm. Explain and suggest a fix.
ex.a:
1. The printer depends on the librarian's PC.
2. After 5 pm the PC is switched off → printer unavailable.
3. Fix: connect the printer directly to the network (network printer) so it works without that PC.
ex.az:
1. 打印机依赖馆员电脑。
2. 5 点后电脑关了 → 不能打印。
3. 改为直接接网络的 network printer。

ex.q: Give ONE advantage of Method A (USB + share) for a small home.
ex.a:
1. Small home, low budget.
2. Answer: easy to set up and no network-capable printer needed; the owner can monitor printing.
ex.az:
1. 家中预算少。
2. 容易设置，不需要有网卡的打印机，可监察打印。

ex.q: A student writes: "Method A is bad because the printer is slower." Why is this wrong?
ex.a:
1. Mistake: it's computer A that slows down, not the printer.
2. Correct: computer A's CPU and RAM are used to handle print jobs, so computer A runs slower.
ex.az:
1. 错误：变慢的是电脑 A，不是打印机。
2. 正确：电脑 A 要用 CPU/RAM 处理打印工作，所以 A 变慢。

demo.title: Two ways to share a printer

frames.en: PC B's job goes to switch → computer A → USB → printer. A must be on and does the work.
frames.zh: PC B 的工作经 switch → 电脑 A → USB → 打印机。A 必须开机并负责处理。

frames.en: A is off, so the job cannot reach the printer.
frames.zh: A 关机，工作到不了打印机。

frames.en: Printer has its own UTP cable to the switch. Job goes straight to it; no PC needed.
frames.zh: 打印机用自己的 UTP 接 switch，工作直达，不用任何电脑。

cards.t: Software sharing and Internet access sharing
cards.en:
Analogy: software sharing is like one textbook in the library that students take turns to read; Internet sharing is like one Wi-Fi bill for the whole flat.

Software sharing: install the software once on a central server. Users run it through remote logon (logging in to the server from another computer) and take turns.

  • Saves software licence cost (pay for fewer copies).
  • No need to install and update every PC.

Internet access service sharing: one device with Internet shares the connection with other devices in the LAN.

  • Reduces cost of service (one subscription).
  • Helps monitor and control incoming/outgoing traffic at one point.

Examples: pocket Wi-Fi; a Windows PC mobile hotspot (you set the SSID and password); a phone sharing mobile data by Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or USB (tethering).

Exam wording: Software sharing saves software licensing cost. Internet access sharing reduces the cost of service and allows the traffic to be monitored and controlled.
cards.zh:
比喻：软件共享像图书馆只有一本书，学生轮流看；上网共享像全屋只交一份 Wi-Fi 费。

软件共享：软件只装在中央 server 一次，用户用 remote logon（从别的电脑登入 server）轮流使用。

  • 节省软件授权费（licence）。
  • 不用每部电脑安装和更新。

上网服务共享：一部已上网的设备把连线分享给 LAN 内其他设备。

  • 减低服务费（只订一份）。
  • 可在一个点监察和控制进出流量。

例子：pocket Wi-Fi；Windows 电脑开 mobile hotspot（设定 SSID 和密码）；手机用 Wi-Fi、Bluetooth 或 USB 分享流动数据。

考试写法：Software sharing saves software licensing cost. Internet access sharing reduces the cost of service and allows the traffic to be monitored and controlled.

ex.q: A school has 40 PCs but only 10 students use a video editor at one time. A licence costs $500 per concurrent user. How much is saved by sharing from a server versus installing on all 40 PCs?
On a trip, Kelly turns on her phone's hotspot so 3 friends' tablets can go online. Name this service and give ONE benefit.
ex.a:
1. One device shares its connection → Internet access service sharing.
2. Benefit: reduces cost: only one mobile data plan is needed.
ex.az:
1. 一部设备分享上网 → Internet access service sharing。
2. 好处：只需一个数据计划，省钱。

ex.q: A student writes: "Software sharing lets everyone use unlimited copies for free." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: licences still apply; you just need fewer.
2. Correct: users take turns via remote logon, which saves licensing cost, not makes it free.
ex.az:
1. 错误：仍要授权，只是需要较少。
2. 正确：用户经 remote logon 轮流用，节省授权费。

cards.tz: 判断 client-server 或 P2P 服务
cards.en:
Quick test: ask "Is one device serving the others, or are devices talking directly as equals?"

  • One device provides a service to many → client-server.
  • Devices communicate directly, no central service → peer-to-peer.
ScenarioTypeWhy
Teacher's desktop shares its printer to all studentsClient-serverIt acts as a print server
Teacher's desktop shares a folder for homeworkClient-serverIt acts as a file server
A student sends a message directly to another student's desktop (command prompt)Peer-to-peerDirect, equal communication
BitTorrent downloadPeer-to-peerPeers send parts to each other

Note: a normal desktop can be a server; what matters is the role.

Exam wording: "This is client-server because the teacher's computer acts as a print/file server that provides the service to the other computers."
cards.zh:
快速判断：问 「是一部设备为其他设备服务，还是设备之间平等地直接沟通？」

  • 一部设备为很多部提供服务 → client-server。
  • 设备直接沟通，没有中央服务 → peer-to-peer。
情境类型原因
老师电脑分享打印机给全班Client-server它是 print server
老师电脑分享交功课文件夹Client-server它是 file server
学生用 command prompt 直接传讯息给另一学生电脑Peer-to-peer直接、平等沟通
BitTorrent 下载Peer-to-peerpeer 互传片段

注意：普通桌面电脑也可以当 server，看的是角色。

考试写法："This is client-server because the teacher's computer acts as a print/file server that provides the service to the other computers."

ex.q: A shop's cashier PCs all read prices from one database computer in the back room. Client-server or P2P?
ex.a:
1. One computer provides price data to all cashiers.
2. Answer: client-server; the back-room computer is a (database) server.
ex.az:
1. 一部电脑为所有收银机提供价格资料。
2. client-server；后房电脑是 database server。

ex.q: Two classmates use AirDrop to send photos phone-to-phone. Client-server or P2P?
ex.a:
1. Phones connect directly; no central server is used.
2. Answer: peer-to-peer.
ex.az:
1. 手机直接连接，没有 server。
2. peer-to-peer。

ex.q: A student says: "The teacher's computer is just a normal desktop, so sharing its printer must be P2P." What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. Mistake: judging by hardware, not by role.
2. The desktop provides a printing service to many clients, so it acts as a print server.
Correct: client-server.
ex.az:
1. 错误：按硬件判断，而不是按角色。
2. 那部电脑为多部 client 提供打印服务，是 print server → client-server。

frames.en: All student PCs send jobs to the teacher's PC, which serves the printer. One serves many → client-server.
frames.zh: 学生电脑都把工作送到老师电脑，由它服务打印机：一服务多 → client-server。

frames.en: Students upload into a folder on the teacher's PC → file server → client-server.
frames.zh: 学生上传到老师电脑文件夹 → file server → client-server。

frames.en: Student 1 sends a message straight to Student 2's PC. Equals talking directly → peer-to-peer.
frames.zh: 学生 1 直接传讯息到学生 2 电脑：平等直接 → peer-to-peer。

cards.t: Network Interface Card (NIC) and MAC address
cards.en:
Analogy: the NIC is a device's "mouth and ears" for the network; the MAC address is like a permanent ID card number printed inside it.

NIC (Network Interface Card): hardware that lets a device communicate over a network, by cable or wirelessly.

  • Ethernet NIC: has an RJ-45 slot for an Ethernet cable.
  • Wireless NIC: usually has antennae to improve signal reception.

MAC address (Media Access Control):

  • 48 bits long = 12 hex digits, written as 6 pairs, e.g. 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E.
  • Unique, assigned by the manufacturer and stored in the hardware.
  • Used to identify a device on a LAN (switches use it to deliver data).
  • Security use: MAC address filtering: only listed MACs may join.

Also note: most NICs are built into the motherboard (through a PCI slot); others connect by USB (e.g. a USB wireless NIC). On Windows, the command getmac in Command Prompt shows the MAC (physical) address; each hex digit = 4 bits, so 12 hex digits = 48 bits.

Exam wording: A NIC allows a device to communicate over a network. Each NIC has a unique 48-bit MAC address, assigned by the manufacturer, used to identify the device in a network.
cards.zh:
比喻：NIC 是设备上网的「口和耳」；MAC address 像印在里面、不会变的身份证号码。

NIC（网络接口卡）：让设备经电缆或无线在网络上通讯的硬件。

  • Ethernet NIC：有 RJ-45 插口接网线。
  • Wireless NIC：通常有天线，改善接收。

MAC address：

  • 48 bits = 12 个十六进制数字，写成 6 组，如 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E。
  • 独一无二，由厂商设定并储存在硬件。
  • 用来在 LAN 识别设备（switch 靠它送数据）。
  • 保安：MAC address filtering，只准名单上的 MAC 连线。

补充：大部分 NIC 内置于主机板（经 PCI 插槽），也有用 USB 连接的（如 USB 无线网卡）。Windows 命令提示字元输入 getmac 可看 MAC（physical）address；每个十六进制数字 = 4 bits，12 个 = 48 bits。

考试写法：A NIC allows a device to communicate over a network. Each NIC has a unique 48-bit MAC address, assigned by the manufacturer, used to identify the device in a network.

ex.q: How many hexadecimal digits are in a MAC address? Show why.
ex.a:
1. MAC = 48 bits.
2. 1 hex digit = 4 bits.
3. 48 ÷ 4 = 12 hex digits (6 pairs).
ex.az:
1. MAC 48 bits。
2. 每个 hex 数字 4 bits。
3. 48 ÷ 4 = 12 个（6 组）。

ex.q: Is 00:1G:2B:3C:4D:5E a valid MAC address?
ex.a:
1. Hex digits are 0–9 and A–F only.
2. 'G' is not a hex digit.
Answer: not valid.
ex.az:
1. hex 只有 0–9、A–F。
2. G 不是 → 无效。

ex.q: A student says: "The MAC address changes every time you join a new Wi-Fi, like an IP address." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: mixing up MAC and IP.
2. Correct: the MAC address is assigned by the manufacturer and stored in the NIC hardware; the IP address is the one given by the network and can change.
ex.az:
1. 错误：混淆 MAC 与 IP。
2. 正确：MAC 由厂商设定、存于硬件；会因网络改变的是 IP address。

frames.en: The router/AP stores a list of allowed MAC addresses.
frames.zh: router／AP 储存允许的 MAC 名单。

frames.en: Laptop's MAC is on the list → connected.
frames.zh: 手提电脑的 MAC 在名单上 → 成功连线。

frames.en: Phone's MAC is not on the list → rejected.
frames.zh: 手机的 MAC 不在名单 → 被拒。

cards.en:
Analogy: a switch is like a building's mailroom that knows which flat each person lives in. A letter goes only to that flat, not to every door.

How a switch works:

  1. Devices in a LAN plug into the switch's ports (it is a multiport device).
  2. The switch learns which MAC address is on which port (MAC address table).
  3. When data (a frame) arrives, it reads the destination MAC and sends it only out of the matching port.
  4. If several devices send at once, data buffering (caching) holds frames briefly to prevent data collision.

Exam wording: A switch connects devices to form a LAN and directs incoming data to the destination device based on its MAC address. Data buffering in a switch prevents data collision.
cards.zh:
比喻：switch 像大厦收发室，知道每个人住哪个单位，信只送到那一户，不会派给每户。

运作：

  1. LAN 设备插到 switch 的 port（它是 multiport device）。
  2. switch 记住每个 MAC address 在哪个 port（MAC 表）。
  3. 数据（frame）到达时，读目的 MAC，只从对应 port 送出。
  4. 几部设备同时发送时，data buffering（缓存）暂存 frame，防止 data collision（数据碰撞）。

考试写法：A switch connects devices to form a LAN and directs incoming data to the destination device based on its MAC address. Data buffering in a switch prevents data collision.

ex.q: PC A sends a frame to PC C through a switch. Which devices receive it?
ex.a:
1. Switch reads destination MAC = PC C.
2. Looks up its table: PC C is on port 3.
3. Sends out of port 3 only.
Answer: only PC C.
ex.az:
1. 读目的 MAC = PC C。
2. 查表：在 port 3。
3. 只从 port 3 送出 → 只有 PC C 收到。

ex.q: PC A and PC B both send to the printer at the same instant. What does the switch do?
ex.a:
1. Two frames for the same port at once could collide.
2. The switch buffers one frame and sends them one after the other.
Answer: data buffering prevents data collision.
ex.az:
1. 同时送往同一 port 可能碰撞。
2. switch 先暂存一个，轮流送出 → 防止碰撞。

ex.q: A student writes: "A switch uses IP addresses to send data to the right computer." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: IP addresses are used by routers.
2. Correct: a switch directs data based on the MAC address of the destination device within a LAN.
ex.az:
1. 错误：用 IP 的是 router。
2. 正确：switch 按目的设备的 MAC address 在 LAN 内转送。

frames.t: A sends a frame to C
frames.en: Frame header: destination MAC …:CC.
frames.zh: frame 头写着目的 MAC …:CC。

frames.t: Switch looks up its MAC table
frames.en: Table: …:AA→port1, …:BB→port2, …:CC→port3.
frames.zh: MAC 表：…:AA→port1、…:BB→port2、…:CC→port3。

frames.en: Only PC C gets the frame. PC B sees nothing.
frames.zh: 只有 PC C 收到，PC B 完全收不到。

frames.en: A and B both send to C. Switch buffers B's frame until A's is done: no collision.
frames.zh: A、B 同时送往 C，switch 暂存 B 的 frame，等 A 送完：没有碰撞。

cards.tz: 接入点与 Wi-Fi 漫游
cards.en:
Analogy: an AP is like a "wireless plug" stuck onto the wired network, so phones can connect without cables. Roaming is like walking between rooms of one school and your phone quietly hands over to the nearest AP.

Access Point (AP): connects to a wired LAN (normally Ethernet) and gives Wi-Fi to other devices, forming a WLAN (wireless LAN).

  • SSID: the network name you see in the Wi-Fi list.
  • Encryption key (password) needed if encryption is on.
  • Admin can limit the maximum number of concurrent users to keep performance OK.

Wi-Fi roaming:

  1. All APs use the same SSID.
  2. You walk out of AP 1's area into AP 2's area.
  3. The wireless NIC disconnects from AP 1 and connects to AP 2 automatically: a seamless switch.

Mesh Wi-Fi: several home router nodes connect to each other to cover a whole flat.

Exam wording: An AP connects to a wired LAN and provides wireless connection to devices to form a WLAN. For roaming, all APs should have the same SSID so devices switch between APs automatically and seamlessly.
cards.zh:
比喻：AP 像插在有线网络上的「无线插头」，手机不用线就能连。roaming 像你在学校由一个课室走到另一个，手机自动转到最近的 AP。

Access Point (AP)：接到有线 LAN（通常是 Ethernet），用 Wi-Fi 让其他设备连线，组成 WLAN（无线局域网）。

  • SSID：Wi-Fi 列表上看到的网络名称。
  • 开了加密就要 encryption key（密码）。
  • 管理员可限制同时连线人数，保持效能。

Wi-Fi roaming：

  1. 所有 AP 用同一个 SSID。
  2. 你从 AP 1 范围走到 AP 2 范围。
  3. 无线 NIC 自动断开 AP 1、接上 AP 2，无缝切换。

Mesh Wi-Fi：多个家用 router 节点互相连接，覆盖全屋。

考试写法：An AP connects to a wired LAN and provides wireless connection to devices to form a WLAN. For roaming, all APs should have the same SSID so devices switch between APs automatically and seamlessly.

ex.q: A school installs 3 APs named "ABC-WiFi-1", "ABC-WiFi-2", "ABC-WiFi-3". Students say their tablets drop Wi-Fi when moving between floors. Explain and fix.
ex.a:
1. Different SSIDs → tablets treat them as different networks and do not roam automatically.
2. Fix: give all APs the same SSID (and same password), e.g. "ABC-WiFi".
3. Then the NIC switches AP automatically and seamlessly.
ex.az:
1. SSID 不同 → 当成不同网络，不会自动漫游。
2. 所有 AP 改用同一 SSID 和密码。
3. NIC 就能自动无缝切换。

ex.q: Why might the admin limit an AP to 30 concurrent users?
ex.a:
1. All users share the AP's bandwidth.
2. Too many users → each gets very little → slow.
Answer: to control traffic and keep a decent performance for connected users.
ex.az:
1. 所有用户共用 AP 带宽。
2. 人太多会慢 → 限制人数以控制流量、维持效能。

ex.q: A student writes: "An AP connects the school LAN to the Internet." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: that is the job of a router (LAN ↔ WAN).
2. Correct: an AP connects wireless devices to a wired LAN, forming a WLAN.
ex.az:
1. 错误：连接 LAN 与 Internet 是 router 的工作。
2. 正确：AP 把无线设备接入有线 LAN，组成 WLAN。

frames.en: Tablet in Room 101 is connected to AP 1 (SSID "ABC-WiFi").
frames.zh: 平板在 101 室，连着 AP 1（SSID "ABC-WiFi"）。

frames.en: Signal from AP 1 gets weak as the student walks down the corridor.
frames.zh: 走到走廊，AP 1 讯号变弱。

frames.en: Same SSID, so the NIC disconnects from AP 1 and connects to AP 2 automatically. The video call keeps going.
frames.zh: SSID 相同，NIC 自动断开 AP 1、接上 AP 2，视像通话不断。

cards.en:
Analogy: a router is like a post office sorting centre. It reads the address on the parcel (IP address) and decides which road to send it down next.

What a router does:

  • Connects LANs with each other, or a LAN with a WAN (e.g. your home network with the Internet).
  • Forwards data packets based on the destination IP address.
  • On the Internet, many routers lie between source and destination. Each one determines the next network node (next hop), i.e. chooses the path.

A home router is usually a 3-in-1 box: router + switch + wireless AP.

All-in-one home router: besides routing, it also has the functions of a switch, access point, DNS server and firewall, so non-professional users can set up a home network easily. Commercial networks use separate devices. A router can also separate two subnets (e.g. a private network and a guest network) and block data between them to increase security.

Routing = finding the best network path; each router decides the next node to forward a packet to.

Exam wording: A router connects LANs with each other or connects a LAN with a WAN. It forwards incoming data to the destination based on the IP address and determines the next network node to send the packet to.
cards.zh:
比喻：router 像邮政分拣中心，看包裹上的地址（IP address），决定下一程走哪条路。

功能：

  • 连接 LAN 与 LAN，或 LAN 与 WAN（例如家中网络与 Internet）。
  • 按目的 IP address 转发数据包（packet）。
  • Internet 上源头和目的地之间有很多 router，每部决定下一个网络节点（next hop），即选择路径。

家用 router 通常三合一：router + switch + wireless AP。

多合一家用路由器：除路由外，还有 switch、access point、DNS server 及 firewall 的功能，方便非专业用户建立家居网络。商业网络则用独立设备。Router 也可分隔两个子网（如私人网络与访客网络），阻挡两者之间的数据以提高保安。

Routing（路由）＝找出最佳网络路径；每个 router 决定封包下一个要转发的节点。

考试写法：A router connects LANs with each other or connects a LAN with a WAN. It forwards incoming data to the destination based on the IP address and determines the next network node to send the packet to.

ex.q: A packet goes from a home PC to a web server in the US. What does each router on the way do?
ex.a:
1. Reads the packet's destination IP address.
2. Checks its routing table.
3. Chooses the next node (next hop) and forwards the packet.
4. Repeats at each router until it reaches the server's network.
ex.az:
1. 读目的 IP。
2. 查路由表。
3. 选下一节点并转发。
4. 每部 router 重复，直到到达。

ex.q: A home router box has 4 LAN ports and Wi-Fi. Name the THREE devices combined in it.
ex.a:
1. LAN ports linking home PCs by MAC → switch.
2. Wi-Fi for phones → wireless access point.
3. Link to ISP/Internet by IP → router.
ex.az:
1. LAN 端口 → switch。
2. Wi-Fi → AP。
3. 接 ISP/Internet → router。

ex.q: A student writes: "A router sends data using the MAC address of the final destination computer." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: routers work with IP addresses across networks; MAC is for delivery inside a LAN (switch).
2. Correct: a router forwards packets based on the destination IP address.
ex.az:
1. 错误：跨网络转发看 IP；MAC 是 LAN 内（switch）用的。
2. 正确：router 按目的 IP address 转发。

frames.en: PC sends a packet to IP 93.184.216.34. The home router sees it is outside the LAN and forwards it to the ISP.
frames.zh: PC 送 packet 到 IP 93.184.216.34，家用 router 发现不在 LAN 内，转给 ISP。

frames.en: Two possible paths. The ISP router chooses the best next node (Router 3).
frames.zh: 有两条路，ISP router 选最佳下一节点（Router 3）。

frames.en: Router 3 forwards to the server's network. Delivered.
frames.zh: Router 3 转发到服务器网络，送达。

cards.en:
The trap: "A switch controls traffic between different networks." Wrong.

SwitchRouter
WorksInside one LANBetween networks (LAN↔LAN, LAN↔WAN)
UsesMAC addressIP address
JobSends a frame only to the port of the destination deviceChooses the next node/path for a packet
AnalogyMailroom inside one buildingPost office between cities

Memory trick: Switch = Same network, MAC. Router = Remote network, IP.

Exam wording: A switch is a multiport device that manages the flow of data in a LAN using MAC addresses. A router forwards data packets between two networks using IP addresses.
cards.zh:
陷阱：「switch 控制不同网络之间的流量」是错的。

SwitchRouter
范围同一个 LAN 内网络之间（LAN↔LAN、LAN↔WAN）
依据MAC addressIP address
工作只把 frame 送到目的设备的 port为 packet 选下一节点／路径
比喻大厦内收发室城市之间的邮局

记法：Switch = Same network（同网，MAC）；Router = Remote network（远程，IP）。

考试写法：A switch is a multiport device that manages the flow of data in a LAN using MAC addresses. A router forwards data packets between two networks using IP addresses.

ex.q: True or false: "A switch controls the network traffic between different networks."
ex.a:
1. Mistake in the statement: "between different networks" describes a router.
2. Answer: False. A switch manages data flow within a LAN using MAC addresses; a router forwards packets between networks using IP addresses.
ex.az:
1. 句子错在「不同网络之间」是 router 的工作。
2. 答：错。switch 用 MAC 管理 LAN 内流量；router 用 IP 在网络间转发。

ex.q: A school wants to join the Science Lab LAN and the Library LAN, and connect both to the Internet. Which device is essential?
ex.a:
1. Joining two networks and the Internet = between networks.
2. Answer: router (switches are still used inside each LAN).
ex.az:
1. 连接不同网络和 Internet → router。
2. 每个 LAN 内仍用 switch。

ex.q: State which device: (a) reads the destination MAC; (b) reads the destination IP; (c) has to choose a path.
ex.a:
1. (a) Switch.
2. (b) Router.
3. (c) Router (determines the next network node).
ex.az: (a) switch (b) router (c) router

frames.en: PC A → PC B in the same office. Switch reads MAC …:BB, sends to that port only. No router needed.
frames.zh: 同一办公室 PC A → PC B：switch 读 MAC …:BB，只送到该 port，不需 router。

frames.en: PC A → website. Switch passes the frame to the router port; the router reads the destination IP and forwards to the Internet.
frames.zh: PC A → 网站：switch 把 frame 交给 router；router 读目的 IP，转发到 Internet。

frames.en: Same network → switch (MAC). Different network → router (IP).
frames.zh: 同网络 → switch（MAC）；不同网络 → router（IP）。

cards.tz: 数据机、ADSL/SDSL 与光纤数据机
cards.en:
Analogy: a modem is a translator. Your computer speaks "digital" (on/off pulses); the phone line or cable carries "analog" waves or light. The modem translates both ways.

Modem = modulator + demodulator, usually given by the ISP.

  • Modulation: combine the digital signal with a carrier wave to make an analog signal to send.
  • Demodulation: turn the received analog signal back into digital.

Home chain: computer → router → modem → ISP exchange → Internet.

DSL modem uses ordinary copper telephone lines:

ADSL (Asymmetric)SDSL (Symmetric)
SpeedDownload much faster than uploadSame upload and download
ForHomes (mostly browse/stream)Businesses (upload a lot, host servers)

Fibre modem (ONT, Optical Network Terminal): converts between light signals and electrical signals.

Exam wording: A modem converts between the analog signals from the Internet and the digital signals from computers (modulation and demodulation).
cards.zh:
比喻：modem 是翻译员：电脑讲「数码」（开／关脉冲），电话线或光纤传「模拟」波或光，modem 双向翻译。

Modem = modulator + demodulator，通常由 ISP 提供。

  • Modulation（调制）：把数码讯号加到 carrier wave（载波），变成模拟讯号发送。
  • Demodulation（解调）：把收到的模拟讯号变回数码。

家中路径：电脑 → router → modem → ISP 交换站 → Internet。

DSL modem 用普通铜质电话线：

ADSL（不对称）SDSL（对称）
速度下载比上载快很多上下载一样
对象家庭（多浏览、串流）商业（大量上载、架 server）

光纤 modem（ONT）：光讯号与电讯号互换。

考试写法：A modem converts between the analog signals from the Internet and the digital signals from computers (modulation and demodulation).

ex.q: A company uploads large video files to clients every day and hosts its own web server. ADSL or SDSL?
ex.a:
1. They need fast upload as well as download.
2. ADSL upload is much slower.
Answer: SDSL, because upstream and downstream bandwidth are the same.
ex.az:
1. 需要快速上载。
2. ADSL 上载慢 → 选 SDSL，上下行带宽相同。

ex.q: Describe what the modem does when a user downloads a web page.
ex.a:
1. Analog signal arrives from the telephone line.
2. Modem demodulates it into a digital signal.
3. Sends the digital data to the router/computer.
ex.az:
1. 电话线送来模拟讯号。
2. modem 解调成数码。
3. 交给 router／电脑。

ex.q: A student writes: "Modulation converts analog signals into digital signals." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: direction reversed.
2. Correct: modulation = digital → analog (for sending); demodulation = analog → digital (for receiving).
ex.az:
1. 错误：方向倒转。
2. 正确：modulation 数码→模拟（发送）；demodulation 模拟→数码（接收）。

demo.title: Upload and download through a modem

frames.t: Upload: digital out of the PC
frames.en: The PC sends digital data (0s and 1s) through the router to the modem.
frames.zh: 电脑把数码数据（0 和 1）经 router 送到 modem。

frames.en: The modem combines the data with a carrier wave → analog signal on the telephone line.
frames.zh: modem 把数据加到载波 → 电话线上的模拟讯号。

frames.en: Reply comes back as analog; the modem demodulates it into digital for the computer.
frames.zh: 回传的是模拟讯号，modem 解调成数码给电脑。

cards.tz: 拨号调制解调器与窄带
cards.en:
Plain idea: before broadband, homes went online with a dial-up modem that "phoned" the ISP. It used the whole phone line.

  • A dial-up modem sends data through an ordinary telephone line.
  • While online, you cannot make phone calls on the same line.
  • Maximum speed only 56 kbps (kilobits per second), called narrowband.
  • It has mostly been replaced by today's modems (DSL, fibre), which use a wider frequency (broadband) so phone calls are not disrupted.
Dial-upDSL (ADSL/SDSL)
LineTelephone lineCopper telephone line
Phone calls while online?NoYes
SpeedUp to 56 kbps (narrowband)Much faster (broadband)

Exam wording: A dial-up modem transmits data through a telephone line at up to 56 kbps (narrowband), and the line cannot be used for phone calls at the same time.
cards.zh:
简单理解：宽带出现前，家庭用拨号 modem「打电话」给 ISP 上网，会占用整条电话线。

  • Dial-up modem 经普通电话线传送数据。
  • 上网时同一条线不能打电话。
  • 最高速度只有 56 kbps，称为 narrowband（窄带）。
  • 现已大多被 DSL、光纤 modem 取代，它们用较阔的频率（broadband），不会干扰电话。
Dial-upDSL（ADSL/SDSL）
线路电话线铜电话线
上网时可打电话？不可可以
速度最高 56 kbps（窄带）快得多（宽带）

考试写法：A dial-up modem transmits data through a telephone line at up to 56 kbps (narrowband), and the line cannot be used for phone calls at the same time.

ex.q: How long does a 7 MB file take on a 56 kbps dial-up line (1 MB = 8 000 000 bits here)?
Give TWO reasons dial-up was replaced by DSL.
ex.a:
1. DSL is much faster (broadband vs 56 kbps narrowband).
2. With DSL you can make phone calls while online.
ex.az:
1. DSL 快得多。
2. DSL 上网时仍可打电话。

ex.q: A student says: "Narrowband means a fibre line that is very thin." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: narrowband is about speed/frequency range, not cable thickness.
2. Narrowband = low data rate such as dial-up's 56 kbps.
ex.az:
1. 错误：窄带指速度／频率范围，不是线的粗幼。
2. 例如拨号的 56 kbps。

cards.t: Twisted pair cables: UTP and STP
cards.en:
Analogy: twisting two wires together is like two people walking in step so outside noise affects both equally and cancels out. Adding a foil shield is like wearing ear muffs too.

Twisted pair cable: pairs of copper wires twisted together, ending in an RJ-45 connector.

  • Twisting reduces electromagnetic interference (EMI) (noise from motors, power lines) and crosstalk (noise leaking from neighbouring wire pairs).
  • Maximum length about 100 m.
UTP (Unshielded)STP (Shielded)
Build4 twisted pairs, no shieldEach pair wrapped in a metal shield
ProsLower cost; easier to installLess affected by EMI, more stable, faster
ConsAffected by EMI; <100 mHigher cost; harder to install; <100 m

Category ratings: common UTP types are Cat6 (max 1 Gbps) and Cat6a (max 10 Gbps). Twisted pair reaches only about 100 m; a repeater can join cables to extend coverage, and fibre optic is used for longer distances, especially in WAN links.

Exam wording: Twisting the copper wires reduces electromagnetic interference and crosstalk. STP is less affected by EMI than UTP but has a higher cost.
cards.zh:
比喻：两条线扭在一起，像两个人齐步走，外来噪音对两条线影响一样而互相抵消；加金属屏蔽层就像再戴耳罩。

Twisted pair cable（双绞线）：多对扭在一起的铜线，末端是 RJ-45 接头。

  • 扭绞减少 electromagnetic interference (EMI，电磁干扰)（摩打、电线）和 crosstalk（串扰，相邻线对漏过来的噪音）。
  • 最长约 100 米。
UTP（无屏蔽）STP（有屏蔽）
结构4 对双绞线，无屏蔽每对包金属屏蔽
优点便宜、易安装较少受 EMI 影响，较稳定、较快
缺点受 EMI 影响；<100 米较贵、较难装；<100 米

类别：常见 UTP 有 Cat6（最高 1 Gbps）及 Cat6a（最高 10 Gbps）。双扭线只能约 100 米；可用 repeater（中继器）连接延长覆盖，较长距离（尤其 WAN）则用光纤。

考试写法：Twisting the copper wires reduces electromagnetic interference and crosstalk. STP is less affected by EMI than UTP but has a higher cost.

ex.q: A factory network runs next to large electric motors. UTP or STP? Why?
ex.a:
1. Motors create strong EMI.
2. UTP is affected by EMI → errors, unstable link.
Answer: STP, because each pair is shielded, so it is less affected by EMI.
ex.az:
1. 摩打产生强 EMI。
2. UTP 受干扰 → 选 STP，有屏蔽，受 EMI 影响较少。

ex.q: An office needs to link a PC 150 m away from the switch. Can one twisted pair cable do it?
ex.a:
1. Twisted pair maximum ≈ 100 m.
2. 150 m > 100 m → signal too weak.
Answer: No; add a switch in between (two runs of ≤100 m) or use fibre.
ex.az:
1. 双绞线上限约 100 米。
2. 150 > 100 → 不行；中间加 switch 或改用光纤。

ex.q: A student writes: "The wires are twisted to make the cable stronger." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: twisting is not for strength.
2. Correct: twisting reduces electromagnetic interference and crosstalk.
ex.az:
1. 错误：扭绞不是为了坚固。
2. 正确：扭绞减少 EMI 和 crosstalk。

cards.en:
Analogy: shine a torch into a long, shiny, bendy water slide. The light keeps bouncing off the walls and comes out the far end. That is a fibre.

Fibre optic cable: thin strands of silica (glass) carrying data as pulses of light.

How light stays inside: total internal reflection

  1. The core is optically denser than the cladding around it.
  2. Light hits the core-cladding boundary at an angle greater than the critical angle.
  3. So it is totally reflected, again and again, all along the fibre.

Pros: fastest transmission; not affected by EMI (light, not electricity) so little data loss; long distances; thin and light. Used for WAN backbones and submarine cables.

Cons: highest cost; hard to install; easily damaged by bending. A visual fault locator (VFL) shines red light in; where light leaks out, the fibre is broken.

Also note: an optical transceiver is needed to send and receive light signals. An optical fibre is about 0.05 mm across (slightly thicker than a hair). Excessive bending can break it, so changes after installation are not recommended. A flashlight or visual fault locator (VFL) can test a cable: light leaking out shows a bend or break. Sir Charles Kao ("Father of Fibre Optics") won the 2009 Nobel Prize in Physics for this work.

Exam wording: Fibre optic cable transmits data as light by total internal reflection. It has the fastest speed, is not affected by EMI and has less distance restriction, but it is expensive and hard to install.
cards.zh:
比喻：用电筒照进一条又长又亮、会弯的滑水梯，光不断在壁上反射，最后从另一端出来，这就是光纤。

Fibre optic cable（光纤）：silica（玻璃）细丝，以光脉冲传数据。

光为何不漏出：total internal reflection（全内反射）

  1. core（纤芯）的光学密度比外层 cladding（包层）大。
  2. 光以大于临界角的角度射到交界。
  3. 于是完全反射，一路反射到尽头。

优点：速度最快；不受 EMI 影响（用光不用电），数据流失少；可传很远；轻而幼。用于 WAN 骨干和海底电缆。

缺点：成本最高；难安装；弯折易损坏。VFL（visual fault locator）射入红光，漏光处就是断点。

补充：需要光收发器（optical transceiver）收发光讯号。光纤直径约 0.05 mm，比头发略粗。过度弯曲会令其断裂，所以安装后不宜更改。可用电筒或 visual fault locator（VFL）测试：有光漏出即代表有弯折或断裂。「光纤之父」高锟爵士因此获 2009 年诺贝尔物理学奖。

考试写法：Fibre optic cable transmits data as light by total internal reflection. It has the fastest speed, is not affected by EMI and has less distance restriction, but it is expensive and hard to install.

ex.q: Two campus buildings are 800 m apart. Which cable should link them? Give TWO reasons.
ex.a:
1. 800 m is far beyond UTP's 100 m.
2. Answer: fibre optic.
3. Reasons: less distance restriction; fastest speed and not affected by EMI.
ex.az:
1. 800 米远超 UTP 100 米上限。
2. 用光纤：距离限制少、最快、不受 EMI 影响。

ex.q: Why is fibre used for submarine cables between continents?
ex.a:
1. Very long distance → needs low signal loss.
2. Huge data volume → needs the highest speed.
Answer: fibre has less distance restriction, fastest speed and no EMI.
ex.az:
1. 距离极长，要低损耗。
2. 数据量巨大，要最快 → 光纤。

ex.q: A student writes: "Fibre is fast because electricity travels quickly through glass." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: glass does not carry electricity.
2. Correct: data travels as light pulses, kept in the core by total internal reflection; that is also why it is not affected by EMI.
ex.az:
1. 错误：玻璃不导电。
2. 正确：数据以光脉冲传送，靠全内反射留在纤芯，所以不受 EMI 影响。

frames.en: A laser at the sender turns 1s into light pulses and shines them into the glass core.
frames.zh: 发送端激光把 1 变成光脉冲，射入玻璃纤芯。

frames.en: The ray reaches the core-cladding boundary at more than the critical angle.
frames.zh: 光线以大于临界角射到纤芯与包层交界。

frames.en: All the light reflects back into the core. This repeats thousands of times along the fibre.
frames.zh: 光全部反射回纤芯，一路重复几千次。

frames.en: A light sensor turns pulses back into electrical signals. No EMI can affect light in glass.
frames.zh: 光感应器把光脉冲变回电讯号；玻璃中的光不受 EMI 影响。

cards.tz: HomePlug（电力线网络）与 Mesh Wi-Fi
cards.en:
Plain idea: both solve the same home problem: one router's Wi-Fi does not reach every room.

  • HomePlug (powerline networking): sends network data through the existing electrical wiring. Plug one unit near the router and another in a far room; that power outlet becomes a wired or wireless access point. Good for fixing the small coverage of one AP.
  • Mesh Wi-Fi: several wireless home routers (nodes) in a single network, all connected to each other like a mesh (not a tree). Data can take the best path currently available, sharing traffic and reducing congestion. Useful in a smart home with many devices.
HomePlugMesh Wi-Fi
Carries data byPower wiringWireless links between nodes
Main benefitNo new cables; reach far roomsBest-path routing, less congestion, many devices

Exam wording: A mesh Wi-Fi system interconnects multiple wireless routers as nodes so that data goes through the best available path, reducing network congestion.
cards.zh:
简单理解：两者都解决同一个家居问题：一部 router 的 Wi-Fi 去不到每个房间。

  • HomePlug（powerline networking，电力线网络）：经现有电线传送网络数据。一个插在 router 旁，另一个插在远处房间，该电源插座就变成有线或无线 access point，可补足单一 AP 覆盖范围小的问题。
  • Mesh Wi-Fi：同一网络内有多部无线家用路由器（节点），互相连接成网状（不是树状）。数据可经当时最佳路径传送，分担流量、减少挤塞，适合有大量设备的智能家居。
HomePlugMesh Wi-Fi
传送媒介电线节点之间的无线连接
主要好处不用新布线；接到远处房间最佳路径、少挤塞、支持大量设备

考试写法：A mesh Wi-Fi system interconnects multiple wireless routers as nodes so that data goes through the best available path, reducing network congestion.

ex.q: Chris's bedroom is far from the router and thick walls block Wi-Fi. He cannot run new cables. Suggest a solution.
ex.a:
1. Use a HomePlug (Wi-Fi HomePlug).
2. It carries data through existing power wiring to an outlet in his bedroom.
3. That outlet provides a wired/wireless access point near him.
ex.az:
1. 用 Wi-Fi HomePlug。
2. 经现有电线把数据送到睡房插座。
3. 插座提供接近他的接入点。

ex.q: A smart home has 40 smart devices and Wi-Fi often becomes slow. Why may mesh Wi-Fi help?
ex.a:
1. Mesh uses several interconnected routers (nodes).
2. Traffic is shared and data takes the best available path.
3. This reduces network congestion when many devices connect.
ex.az:
1. 多个互连节点。
2. 分担流量，走最佳路径。
3. 减少大量设备造成的挤塞。

ex.q: A student says: "Mesh Wi-Fi is a tree: every AP must talk only to the main router." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: that is a tree structure.
2. In mesh, nodes are interconnected with each other, so data can take different paths.
ex.az:
1. 错误：那是树状结构。
2. Mesh 节点互相连接，数据可走不同路径。

cards.en:
Analogy: satellite is like shouting to a friend via a mirror in the sky: reaches anywhere, but slow and pricey. Microwave is like a laser pointer between two rooftops: needs a clear straight line.

SatelliteMicrowave
UseRemote areas with no wired connection (ships, mountains, Starlink)Point-to-point link between a terminal and an access point on top of a building
NeedDish pointed at the skyLine of sight (straight, unblocked path)
CostInstallation and monthly fees extremely expensiveLower than laying cable over hard ground
Weak pointsAffected by bad weather and sunspot activity; high latency (long distance to space)Easily affected by weather; blocked by buildings

Radio frequency bands for satellites are allocated by the ITU (International Telecommunication Union).

Exam wording: Satellite can build a network connection in remote areas where wired connection is not accessible, but it is very expensive and its stability is affected by bad weather and sunspot activity. Microwave requires a straight line of sight between terminals.
cards.zh:
比喻：卫星像经天上一面镜跟朋友喊话：哪里都到，但慢又贵；微波像两栋天台之间的激光笔：要清楚的直线。

Satellite 卫星Microwave 微波
用途没有有线网络的偏远地区（船、山区、Starlink）大厦天台接入点与终端点对点连接
要求碟形天线对准天空Line of sight（直线、无阻挡）
成本安装费和月费极贵比在难行地形铺线便宜
弱点受恶劣天气和太阳黑子影响；延迟高易受天气影响；被大厦阻挡

卫星频段由 ITU（国际电信联盟）分配。

考试写法：Satellite can build a network connection in remote areas where wired connection is not accessible, but it is very expensive and its stability is affected by bad weather and sunspot activity. Microwave requires a straight line of sight between terminals.

ex.q: A research ship in the middle of the Pacific needs Internet. Which method? Give ONE drawback.
ex.a:
1. No cables or towers at sea → satellite.
2. Drawback: extremely expensive installation and fees, or unstable in storms, or high latency.
ex.az:
1. 海上没有线路和基站 → 卫星。
2. 缺点：极贵；风暴时不稳；延迟高。

ex.q: A microwave link between two buildings stops working after a new tower is built between them. Why?
ex.a:
1. Microwave needs a straight line of sight.
2. The new tower blocks the path.
Answer: the line of sight is blocked; move the antennas higher or relay through another site.
ex.az:
1. 微波需要直线视线。
2. 新大厦阻挡 → 断线；把天线升高或经中转站。

ex.q: A student says: "Satellite is the best choice for online gaming in a city because it covers everywhere." What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. Mistake: coverage is not the only factor.
2. Satellite has high latency and very high cost; in a city, wired broadband/fibre is available and better.
ex.az:
1. 错误：覆盖不是唯一考虑。
2. 卫星延迟高、成本高；城市有光纤宽带，更适合。

cards.en:
Plain idea: extra facts around satellite and microwave links.

  • WiMAX (Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access): wireless technology using microwave. Needs a straight line of sight between a microwave terminal and an access point on a building top; easily affected by weather.
  • ITU (International Telecommunication Union) allocates frequency bands for satellite communication to avoid interference between users.
  • Satellite weak points: very expensive installation and monthly fees; stability affected by rainstorms, windstorms and sunspot activity.
  • Satellite broadband (Starlink): thousands of low earth orbit (LEO) satellites to give Internet to all areas, especially remote ones (beta: about 80-150 Mbps down, 20-40 ms latency).

GNSS (GPS, BeiDou/BDS): satellites keep broadcasting their sending time and position. The receiver only listens (no two-way communication) and works out its distance from each satellite from the time difference. One satellite only says you are somewhere on a sphere, so the receiver needs at least 4 satellites; where the spheres overlap is its location. This is multilateration.

Exam wording: A GPS receiver calculates its location from the time differences of signals from at least four satellites (multilateration).
cards.zh:
简单理解：卫星与微波相关的补充知识。

  • WiMAX（Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access）：用微波的无线技术。微波终端与大厦顶的接入点之间要有直线视线（line of sight）；易受天气影响。
  • ITU（国际电信联盟）分配卫星通讯频段，避免用户互相干扰。
  • 卫星弱点：安装费及月费极贵；稳定性受暴雨、大风及太阳黑子活动影响。
  • 卫星宽带（Starlink 星链）：用数以千计的低轨（LEO）卫星为全球（尤其偏远地区）提供上网（测试版约 80-150 Mbps 下载，延迟 20-40 ms）。

卫星导航（GPS、北斗 BDS）：卫星不断广播发送时间及自身位置。接收器只接收（没有双向通讯），按时间差计算与每颗卫星的距离。一颗卫星只能确定你在某个球面上，所以要至少 4 颗卫星，球面重叠处就是位置，称为 multilateration（多点定位）。

考试写法：A GPS receiver calculates its location from the time differences of signals from at least four satellites (multilateration).

ex.q: Why must a WiMAX terminal be placed on a rooftop facing the access point?
ex.a:
1. Microwave links need a straight line of sight.
2. Buildings or obstacles in between would block the signal.
ex.az:
1. 微波需要直线视线。
2. 中间有障碍物会阻挡讯号。

ex.q: How many satellites does a GPS receiver need at least, and why?
ex.a:
1. At least 4.
2. One satellite's time difference only places the device on a sphere.
3. The overlap of several spheres gives the exact location (multilateration).
ex.az:
1. 至少 4 颗。
2. 一颗只能确定在某球面上。
3. 多个球面重叠得出位置。

ex.q: A student says: "A phone's GPS sends its location up to the satellites." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: GPS is receive-only.
2. Satellites broadcast time and position; the device only receives and calculates its own location. There is no communication from device to satellite.
ex.az:
1. 错误：GPS 只接收。
2. 设备接收卫星广播自行计算位置，不会传送给卫星。

cards.en:
Analogy: 2.4 GHz is like a deep voice: travels far through walls but the road is crowded (many devices use it). 5 GHz is like a fast-talking voice: quicker, clearer, but doesn't carry far.

Wi-Fi = wireless data transmission using radio waves, based on the IEEE 802.11 standards. Thick walls and obstacles greatly reduce coverage.

2.4 GHz5 GHz
SpeedSlowerFaster
RangeLonger, better through wallsShorter
InterferenceMore (microwave ovens, Bluetooth, phones)Less
  • A dual band router broadcasts both.
  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax): newer standard, more bandwidth and more users at the same time.

Also note: a dual band router supports 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz at the same time. Common sources of 2.4 GHz interference: microwave ovens, mobile phones and Bluetooth. Many homes still use 5 GHz for its higher stability, even though its coverage is smaller.

Exam wording: 5 GHz Wi-Fi has a higher speed and less interference but a shorter range than 2.4 GHz. 2.4 GHz is interfered by microwave ovens and Bluetooth devices.
cards.zh:
比喻：2.4 GHz 像低沉的声音：传得远、穿墙较好，但很多设备挤在同一条路；5 GHz 像语速快的声音：快又清楚，但传不远。

Wi-Fi：用无线电波传数据，基于 IEEE 802.11 标准。厚墙等障碍物会大大减少覆盖范围。

2.4 GHz5 GHz
速度较慢较快
范围较远，较易穿墙较近
干扰较多（微波炉、Bluetooth、手机）较少
  • Dual band router 同时发两个频段。
  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax)：较新标准，带宽更大、可同时连更多用户。

补充：双频路由器（dual band router）可同时支援 2.4 GHz 及 5 GHz。2.4 GHz 常见干扰来源：微波炉、手机及 Bluetooth。5 GHz 覆盖较小，但因较稳定，仍有很多家庭使用。

考试写法：5 GHz Wi-Fi has a higher speed and less interference but a shorter range than 2.4 GHz. 2.4 GHz is interfered by microwave ovens and Bluetooth devices.

ex.q: A student streams 4K video at a desk 2 m from the router. Which band? Why?
ex.a:
1. Short distance, needs high speed.
2. Answer: 5 GHz: faster and less interference; the short range is not a problem at 2 m.
ex.az:
1. 距离近、要高速。
2. 选 5 GHz：较快、干扰少，近距离不怕范围短。

ex.q: Wi-Fi in the kitchen drops every time the microwave oven is used. Explain and suggest a fix.
ex.a:
1. Microwave ovens give off radio noise near 2.4 GHz.
2. This interferes with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.
3. Fix: switch the device to the 5 GHz band (dual band router).
ex.az:
1. 微波炉在 2.4 GHz 附近产生干扰。
2. 干扰 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi。
3. 改用 5 GHz。

ex.q: A student writes: "5 GHz is better in every way, so 2.4 GHz is useless." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: ignores range.
2. Correct: 2.4 GHz has a longer range and passes walls better, so it suits rooms far from the router.
ex.az:
1. 错误：忽略范围。
2. 正确：2.4 GHz 范围较远、较易穿墙，适合离 router 远的房间。

cards.en:
Plain idea: each new Wi-Fi standard is a newer "version" with more bandwidth. Learn the order and the big numbers.

StandardMax rate (bandwidth)FrequencyYear
802.11a54 Mbps5 GHz1999
802.11b11 Mbps2.4 GHz1999
802.11g54 Mbps2.4 GHz2003
802.11n600 Mbps2.4 / 5 GHz2009
802.11ac1 Gbps5 GHz2013
802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6)10 Gbps2.4 / 5 GHz2019

Wi-Fi 6: very high speed, high capacity (more users on one AP at the same time, good for IoT and crowded places like cafés and campuses), extremely low latency, less interference.

Bottleneck rule: a connection is only as fast as its slowest part (wireless NIC, AP, broadband line). Upgrading a part that is not the slowest does not help.

Exam wording: 802.11ac has a higher maximum data rate (1 Gbps) than 802.11g (54 Mbps), and uses the 5 GHz band instead of 2.4 GHz.
cards.zh:
简单理解：每个新 Wi-Fi 标准都是更新的「版本」，带宽更高。记住次序及主要数字。

标准最高速率（带宽）频率年份
802.11a54 Mbps5 GHz1999
802.11b11 Mbps2.4 GHz1999
802.11g54 Mbps2.4 GHz2003
802.11n600 Mbps2.4 / 5 GHz2009
802.11ac1 Gbps5 GHz2013
802.11ax（Wi-Fi 6）10 Gbps2.4 / 5 GHz2019

Wi-Fi 6：速度极高、容量高（同一 AP 可同时连更多用户，利于 IoT 及咖啡店、校园等人多地方）、延迟极低、干扰较少。

樽颈原则：连线速度取决于最慢的一环（无线网卡、AP、宽带线路）。升级不是最慢的部分没有帮助。

考试写法：802.11ac has a higher maximum data rate (1 Gbps) than 802.11g (54 Mbps), and uses the 5 GHz band instead of 2.4 GHz.

ex.q: May must choose APs supporting 802.11g or 802.11ac. State two technical differences.
ex.a:
1. Max data rate: 802.11g 54 Mbps; 802.11ac 1 Gbps.
2. Frequency: 802.11g uses 2.4 GHz; 802.11ac uses 5 GHz.
ex.az:
1. 最高速率：g 54 Mbps；ac 1 Gbps。
2. 频率：g 2.4 GHz；ac 5 GHz。

ex.q: John's line is 100 Mbps, router 1900 Mbps, AP supports 802.11a/b/g/n, but his wireless NIC is 802.11g. Which part limits his speed?
ex.a:
1. The slowest part is the 802.11g wireless NIC (54 Mbps).
2. Upgrading the NIC to 802.11n (600 Mbps) or using a UTP cable to the router would help.
3. Buying a Wi-Fi 6 AP alone would not help, because the NIC stays at 54 Mbps.
ex.az:
1. 最慢是 802.11g 网卡（54 Mbps）。
2. 升级网卡或改用 UTP 直驳会改善。
3. 只换 Wi-Fi 6 AP 没用。

ex.q: A student says: "802.11n only works on 5 GHz." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: 802.11n supports both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz.
2. 802.11a and 802.11ac are the 5 GHz-only ones in the table.

cards.en:
Analogy: Bluetooth is like whispering to someone next to you: short range, low effort. Wi-Fi is like a loudspeaker for the whole room: more power, more data.

Bluetooth: short-distance wireless data transmission between mobile devices (earphones, game controllers, smart bands, keyboards).

  • Radio waves at 2.4 GHz → may interfere with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.
  • Very popular: convenient and highly compatible.
  • Low power consumption; supports peer-to-peer (device-to-device) links.
  • Lower data rate than Wi-Fi, but fine for peripherals.

Factors affecting any wireless signal: distance, obstacles, interference, weather, direction of antenna.

A USB cable beats wireless on data rate, security and interference, but you lose mobility.

Exam wording: Bluetooth is used for short-distance wireless data transmission between mobile devices. It has low power consumption and high compatibility, but a shorter range and lower data rate than Wi-Fi.
cards.zh:
比喻：Bluetooth 像跟身边的人细声说话：距离短、省力；Wi-Fi 像全房间的扩音器：较耗电但数据多。

Bluetooth：流动设备之间的短距离无线数据传输（耳机、游戏手掣、智能手环、键盘）。

  • 用 2.4 GHz 无线电波 → 可能干扰 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi。
  • 方便、兼容性高，非常普及。
  • 耗电低；支持 peer-to-peer（设备直接连接）。
  • 数据率比 Wi-Fi 低，但用于周边设备足够。

影响无线讯号的因素：距离、障碍物、干扰、天气、天线方向。

USB 线在数据率、保安、干扰方面都比无线好，但失去移动性。

考试写法：Bluetooth is used for short-distance wireless data transmission between mobile devices. It has low power consumption and high compatibility, but a shorter range and lower data rate than Wi-Fi.

ex.q: Why do wireless earphones use Bluetooth instead of Wi-Fi?
ex.a:
1. Earphones have tiny batteries → need low power consumption.
2. Only need to reach a phone nearby → short range is fine.
3. Bluetooth is highly compatible with phones.
ex.az:
1. 耳机电池小，要低耗电。
2. 只连身边手机，短距离够。
3. 兼容性高。

ex.q: A user's Bluetooth mouse lags when it is behind a metal laptop stand 5 m away. Give TWO factors causing this.
ex.a:
1. Obstacle: metal blocks radio waves.
2. Distance: 5 m is far for a small Bluetooth device.
(Also possible: interference from 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.)
ex.az:
1. 障碍物：金属阻挡。
2. 距离太远。
（也可答：2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 干扰）

ex.q: A student writes: "Bluetooth uses 5 GHz so it never interferes with Wi-Fi." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Mistake: wrong frequency.
2. Correct: Bluetooth uses 2.4 GHz, so it may interfere with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.
ex.az:
1. 错误：频段错。
2. 正确：Bluetooth 用 2.4 GHz，可能干扰 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi。

cards.en:
Plain idea: three more short-distance wireless technologies, each with its own job.

RFIDNFCZigbee
WhatAutomatically identifies RFID tags and reads/writes data by radio wavesAn extension of RFID; two-way (bi-directional) communicationNetwork standard for low-powered devices
ExampleElectronic Toll Collection (Autotoll), Octopus-style cardsMobile payment, tap-to-share filesSmart home sensors, light bulbs, sockets (IoT)
NoteTags can be read from a few metres away → security risk; RFID-blocking card holdersMore data per time than RFID; lower power and faster connection than BluetoothConnects IoT devices

Exam wording: NFC is an extension of RFID that supports bi-directional communication; compared with Bluetooth it has lower power consumption and a faster connection speed.
cards.zh:
简单理解：另外三种短距离无线技术，各有用途。

RFIDNFCZigbee
是什么用无线电波自动识别 RFID 标签并读写数据RFID 的延伸；支援双向通讯给低耗电设备的网络标准
例子电子收费（快易通 Autotoll）手机付款、碰一碰传文件智能家居感应器、灯泡、插座（IoT）
备注标签可在数米外被读取 → 保安风险；有防 RFID 卡套每次传送数据比 RFID 多；比 Bluetooth 耗电低、连接快连接 IoT 设备
